claim_boundary: Synthetic static relational proof only. Source adapter/control/source history/removal authority/transaction witnesses are assumed trusted inputs. Native CURRENT/manifest codec, source CRC, redb atomicity, sync/auth/holds/recovery NOT_RUN.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: physical-registration
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Resolve actual registered root, schema pointer, generation and dataset.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Unregistered key, foreign Storage ID, malformed value or dangling JSON Pointer blocks publication.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: native-source-codec
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Verify actual CURRENT/manifest bytes and native frame bounds/CRC/decode/schema.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Synthetic control object, caller hash, truncated frame or CRC error never proves source authority.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: global-coverage
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Mixed application/project retained source yields all exact rows and captured watermarks.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Single project maximum, pagination or omitted partition cannot certify the full source.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: empty-source
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Actual selected empty inventory/watermark publishes null cursor/count zero.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Missing source or guessed sequence zero remains unavailable.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: append-preserved-rows
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Native append changes manifest/survivor digest; only new rows and frontier commit.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Rebinding every old row or accepting a frontier without its new rows fails.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: birth-vs-current-controls
native_oracle_pairs.positive: After original manifest overwrite, current canonical prefix plus admitted anchor verifies.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Demanding absent old snapshots on every read or trusting anchor hash without native admission fails.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: read-fence
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Pinned current source/redb snapshot yields matching generation/frontier token.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Manifest/frontier/source/access change before disclosure invalidates token.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: source-ahead-crash
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Crash after durable append before index transaction leaves stale old index until catch-up.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Old index cannot claim new source watermark or successful filtered completion.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: index-transaction-crash
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Crash before/after real redb transaction exposes respectively old/new complete row set.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Rows-only or checkpoint-only partial state is never current.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: sequence-gaps
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Actual lease abandonment or authorized retention map explains exact holes.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Unexplained missing sequence or forged gap ref blocks coverage.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: corruption-loss
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Verified survivors retain degraded health and owner integrity fence.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Healthy relabeling or mutation from degraded proof is rejected.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: unsupported-future
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Stop before an otherwise valid unsupported version, preserve last supported progress.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Skip/quarantine/normalize future schema into current coverage is forbidden.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: compatibility-source
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Supported EventRecord1/2/minimal envelope normalization preserves exact source bytes/schema/identity.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Rewriting canonical legacy bytes or guessing missing project identity is forbidden.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: target-stage
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Complete verified target shadow stays invisible while source CURRENT remains selected.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Staged root or newest timestamp cannot override CURRENT.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: CURRENT-crash
native_oracle_pairs.positive: After synchronized CURRENT target wins; activate exact shadow or rebuild target.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Old-redb/current-root wins over target CURRENT or rollback on restart is forbidden.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: translation
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Actual owner proof joins source/target selection and full preserved semantic identities to target locators.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Sequence-only remap, stale old offset, missing translation artifact or missing source digest forces rebuild.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: retention-removal
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Verified eligible target survivors omit exactly authorized removed source identities.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Checkpoint retirement is never permission to delete canonical source events.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: generation-retirement
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Atomic target activation fixes first retirement time and successor once.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Cursor update, retry or observation cannot reset TTL or retire current early.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: holds-and-slot
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Current hold/ref enumeration allows eligible retired cleanup then serialized slot reservation.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Fourth generation, protected history eviction, stale hold list or staged age-only cleanup is forbidden.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: rebuild-same-source
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Deliberate same-source rebuild allocates new durable seed; restart reuses pending seed.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Same source hashes cannot collide with/revive an old retired generation.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: admission-gates
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Writer rebuild observes real lock/lease/storage budget/coordinator graph admission.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Viewer or failed global I/O gate writes no hidden index/checkpoint.

native_oracle_pairs.subject: filtered-adoption
native_oracle_pairs.positive: Each reader adopts exact changing frontier token and still verifies its domain join.
native_oracle_pairs.negative: Generation-only cache, generic metadata-only completion or silent sibling schema upgrade fails.
